title: Senior Engineering Manager for Workspace Platform
description: RDQ427R634 At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started. The Workspace Platform team is building unified infrastructure that powers critical customer-facing capabilities across the Databricks experience, including content discovery, organization, collaborative editing, and repository management. As a Senior Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of approximately 20 engineers developing shared platform capabilities that are essential to scaling our customer base and supporting the future of agentic AI workloads. The Impact You Will Have Define and drive the technical strategy for the Workspace Platform, establishing shared capabilities that underpin the entire Databricks experience Own the roadmap, execution, and delivery for the platform, ensuring all deliverables meet the highest standards of quality and timeliness Build and scale a world-class engineering team, growing from 10 to 30+ engineers while maintaining high hiring standards and team performance Establish and enforce engineering excellence through design reviews, code quality standards, testing strategies, and performance optimizations for high-volume distributed systems Partner with product, engineering, and business teams across the organization to align technical strategy with company growth objectives and ensure seamless integration across products Evolve organizational structure to support long-term initiatives and balance product roadmap with technical debt management What We Look For 10+ years of software engineering experience 4+ years managing engineering teams, including experience leading managers Proven track record of scaling engineering teams and delivering complex platform initiatives in a SaaS environment Experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems and cloud-native architectures with technologies including AWS, Azure, or GCP Deep understanding of platform engineering, including containerization technologies, microservices architecture, and modern web application frameworks Ability to attract, hire, and develop top-tier engineering talent, including staff+ level engineers and engineering managers Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with the ability to influence technical direction and align stakeholders across multiple teams Experience ensuring high service quality and reliability, including ownership of testing, SLAs, and production operations B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience Pay Range Transparency Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non-commissionable roles or on-target earnings for commissionable roles. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipates utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. For more information regarding which range your location is in visit our page here . Local Pay Range $217,000 — $312,200 USD About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog.
